project_title: Technical Photographer/Videographer for Strict Lighting & Angle Requirements

project_metadata.job_title: Technical Photographer/Videographer for Strict Lighting & Angle Requirements
project_metadata.job_description:
I’m looking for a commercial or product photographer in the Las Vegas area to photograph a three‑panel artwork on a tabletop setup and capture a short 4K walkthrough video. This is a simple, controlled, technical shoot.

If you’re comfortable with clean studio lighting and shooting products or tabletop subjects, you’re already in the right zone.

Project details:

Photograph each of the three panels (8x10 inch).

Specific shot list will be provided.

Shoot a short, approximately 20 second 4K walkthrough video of the artwork while displayed on tabletop.

Bring your own lighting (softbox), suitable for tabletop work.

Use a boom arm or overhead setup to shoot straight down (necessary)

Keep all shots perfectly square and level (important for consistency)

Deliver RAW files + your standard edited versions (TIFF or high‑res JPEG)

Requirements:

Must be based in Las Vegas and able to travel to indoor location within the city.

Ability to shoot RAW

Video capability (simple, steady walkthrough) capturing the artwork according to technical requirements which will be provided for clarification prior to shoot.

Session length:  
Approximately 60–90 minutes.

Looking forward to working with a local photographer who can deliver clean, well‑lit, square overhead, and detail shots for artwork documentation.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], yes, I have a boom arm capable of achieving a 90 degree overhead angle, along with a soft box for diffusing the light. Thanks again, and feel free to send over any other questions.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Great, thank you for verifying that you have both the boom arm and softbox.

I’ll send you the shot list and technical specifications for the tabletop video walkthrough. They will cover the overhead 90° configuration, the lighting, and the brief video walk-through with the piece on display. For documentation purposes, I need video of each of the three panels separately, followed by all three displayed together on the same black velvet tabletop being used for the shoot. ( I have the velvet and table). The clips must be edited into one 20-40 sec video. It should be straightforward. I’m attaching the shot list document to provide more detail and clarity.

If you have any questions, let me know and we can discuss them.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Great, I’ll review everything tonight and follow up in the morning if I have any questions. Thanks [CLIENT_NAME_001]!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: One question... What is the height of the table top, and how high are the ceilings?...

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The table is 29 inches high, and the ceiling height is 8 ft.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Additional note: I have a collapsible table available that would lower the height to 2 inches above the floor. It would provide the flat surface needed for the black velvet while leaving plenty of overhead space to take the photos and record the video comfortably. It should work well provided that the tripod’s boom arm locks at 90 degrees. Wall mounting the art would be ideal for the shoot, but because the documentation will be done on a tabletop, maintaining 90 degrees is necessary to keep the shots square.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], thank you for the information... The shorter table would be the better choice because it will let us position the light at the angle we need, although we should also keep the taller table available in case it becomes necessary. After reviewing your shot list, I can produce what you’re requesting. One final question: could you also provide the size of each panel?... Thank you in advance!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
There are three physical panels, each measuring 8x10 inches. The piece is a triptych.

Please let me know if you require anything else to plan the framing and lighting.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sounds good—yeah, I think we have everything covered! I’m available next week from Wednesday-Friday, preferably in the morning with a 10am start... Including set-up and tear down, we should finish before 1pm, or 2pm at the latest...

Tomorrow morning, I’ll prepare the contract and send it over.
